_comment: The maps the lobby offers. An index file rather than a directory scan because Godot cannot reliably list res:// contents from an exported PCK - anything not listed here would be invisible in a real Android build.

maps.summary: Symmetric land map. A river with three crossings and four neutral cities in the midfield.
Naval map. A deep channel with reefs and shallows divides two coasts, joined by a causeway at each edge.
Compact square duel. A mountain spine splits the field and a neutral airport sits dead centre.
Tall north-south map. A river divides it with only two bridges, so vehicles must commit to a side.
Large naval map. A reef-strewn channel separates the coasts, with a causeway at each edge and a transport apiece.
Two islands with no land between them. Infantry can only reach the enemy HQ by transport, so the channel is the whole game.
